company.description:
UTORG is a licensed fintech company providing regulated crypto infrastructure for consumers and businesses worldwide. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE, UTORG operates across two core verticals.

For consumers, UTORG offers a non-custodial crypto on-ramp and a virtual Visa card enabling direct spending of crypto assets at over 80 million merchants globally. The UTORG app supports instant crypto purchases via 100+ payment methods across 180+ countries, with seamless KYC and competitive rates.

For businesses, UTORG delivers white-label and API-based payment rails enabling platforms, exchanges, and fintech operators to embed regulated crypto on/off-ramp capabilities and stablecoin-powered payment flows into their products. UTORG holds financial licenses in the EU (Lithuania) and operates under regulatory frameworks in multiple jurisdictions.

UTORG's infrastructure is built for scale — processing millions of transactions with high uptime, real-time settlement, and enterprise-grade security. Website: https://utorg.com
